definitions.explanation: The very latest and most technologically advanced version of something. Used as a noun or prenominal modifier to describe equipment, facilities, or systems.

examples.japanese: {最新鋭|さいしんえい}の{設備|せつび}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
この{病院|びょういん}には{最新鋭|さいしんえい}の{医療機器|いりょうきき}が{揃|そろ}っている。
examples.english: This hospital is equipped with cutting-edge medical devices.

examples.japanese: {最新鋭|さいしんえい}の{戦闘機|せんとうき}が{配備|はいび}されたことで、{防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}が{大幅|おおはば}に{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: With the deployment of state-of-the-art fighter jets, defense capability improved significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier before a noun ({最新鋭|さいしんえい}の + noun). Common in technology, military, and industrial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最新鋭|さいしんえい}の{設備|せつび} (state-of-the-art equipment)
- {最新鋭|さいしんえい}の{技術|ぎじゅつ} (cutting-edge technology)
- {最新鋭|さいしんえい}{機|き} (latest-model aircraft/machine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最新|さいしん}: latest, newest — simply the most recent version, without emphasizing technological advancement
- {最先端|さいせんたん}: leading edge, forefront — emphasizes being at the very front of innovation
